name: Azare
sourceReview: Official Bauchi State pages identify BAGIS as the state land/GIS custodian and link the cofo.bauchistate.gov.ng C of O service. The service returned an Azare search result count but no safe parcel geometry. The result is therefore registry evidence only, not source integration/admission.

queryOutcomes.english: Official BAGIS, state application directory, and C of O service found; no safe public parcel API found.
queryOutcomes.hausa: No Hausa-language first-party parcel viewer/API found; results were general land/legal material or the same official state service.
queryOutcomes.citySearch: Azare returned 67 records; unsafe owner/title fields were not retained.
queryOutcomes.exactPoint: 11.6726953788847,10.1878056502206 returned 0; not treated as citywide absence.
queryOutcomes.baugisLanding: Landing page loaded, but current JS/configuration yielded no usable anonymous parcel endpoint.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel/record identifier only when stable and source-proven
excludedFields: certificate details beyond safe source qualification
uncertainty: A state land-record search result count is not cadastral geometry evidence; anonymous search may be partial and the exact point may lie outside indexed records. No integration/admission is recommended until an independent serial reviewer qualifies a real public geometry adapter.
